Home Guard Removed After Woman Assault Video Surfaces

A Home Guard has been removed from service following an alleged assault on a woman near the Hafeezpet Railway Station. A video of the incident circulated online, prompting a response from the South Central Railway (SCR). The SCR confirmed the action taken against the Home Guard.
